title: Saul’s Unlawful Sacrifice

questions.question: How long had Saul reigned when he chose 3,000 men?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:1 (ESV): “Saul lived for one year and then became king, and when he had reigned for two years over Israel, Saul chose three thousand men...”

questions.question: Who defeated the garrison of the Philistines at Geba?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:3 (ESV): “Jonathan defeated the garrison of the Philistines that was at Geba...”

questions.question: Why did the people scatter from Saul at Gilgal?
options: They were afraid of the Philistine army
questions.correctAnswer: They were afraid of the Philistine army
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:6-7 (ESV): “When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble... the people hid in caves... and all the people followed him trembling.”

questions.question: What sin did Saul commit at Gilgal?
options: He offered the burnt offering himself
questions.correctAnswer: He offered the burnt offering himself
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:9 (ESV): “So Saul said, ‘Bring the burnt offering here to me...’ And he offered the burnt offering.”

questions.question: What consequence did Samuel pronounce on Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:14 (ESV): “But now your kingdom shall not continue. The Lord has sought out a man after his own heart...”

questions.question: How many chariots did the Philistines muster?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:5 (ESV): "And the Philistines mustered to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots..."

questions.question: Where did Saul wait for Samuel?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:7-8 (ESV): "...Saul was still at Gilgal... He waited seven days..."

questions.question: Why we there no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel?
options: Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears
questions.correctAnswer: Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:19 (ESV): "Now there was no blacksmith... for the Philistines said, 'Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears.'"

questions.question: Who were the only ones with a sword or spear in Saul's army?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:22 (ESV): "...there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people... but Saul and Jonathan his son had them."

questions.question: Saul excused his action by saying the people were ______ from him.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:11 (ESV): "Saul said, 'When I saw that the people were scattering from me...'"

questions.question: How many men were with Saul after Samuel left?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:15 (ESV): "...And Saul numbered the people who were present with him, about six hundred men."

questions.question: Where did the Philistine raiders go?
options: Ophrah, Beth-horon, and the border overlooking the Valley of Zeboim
questions.correctAnswer: Ophrah, Beth-horon, and the border overlooking the Valley of Zeboim
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:17-18 (ESV): Describes the three companies of raiders turning to these directions.

questions.question: How did the Israelites sharpen their farm tools?
options: They went down to the Philistines
questions.correctAnswer: They went down to the Philistines
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:20 (ESV): "But every one of the Israelites went down to the Philistines to sharpen his plowshare..."

questions.question: What was the price for sharpening a mattock or goad?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:21 (ESV): "and the charge was a pim for the plowshares..."

questions.question: Samuel told Saul he had done ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:13 (ESV): "And Samuel said to Saul, 'You have done foolishly. You have not kept the command of the LORD...'"

key_verse_text: But now your kingdom shall not continue. The LORD has sought out a man after his own heart... (ESV)
